		if not (#removedIndexes > 0 and removedIndexes[#removedIndexes] == i+1) then

replacements.new:
-- Preserve UTF-8 characters as a single typewriter unit instead of replacing
	-- non-ASCII bytes. Turkish localization depends on this for ç, ğ, ı, İ, ö, ş, ü.
	local i = 1
	while i <= #textData.toWrite do
		local firstByte = string.byte(textData.toWrite[i])
		local byteCount = 1

		if firstByte and firstByte >= 240 then
			byteCount = 4
		elseif firstByte and firstByte >= 224 then
			byteCount = 3
		elseif firstByte and firstByte >= 194 then
			byteCount = 2
		end

		if byteCount > 1 then
			local character = textData.toWrite[i]
			local validSequence = true
			for _ = 2, byteCount do
				local continuation = textData.toWrite[i + 1]
				local continuationByte = continuation and string.byte(continuation)
				if not continuationByte or continuationByte < 128 or continuationByte > 191 then
					validSequence = false
					break
				end
				character = character .. continuation
				table.remove(textData.toWrite, i + 1)
			end
			if validSequence then
				textData.toWrite[i] = character
			end
		end

		i = i + 1
	end
